pages.text: By keeping the following items in your inventory (or the inventory of your rocket), you'll be able to build a $(item)Space Station$() in orbit once you launch!$(br)$(li)43x Aluminium Frame$(li)24x Glass Plate$(li)4x Glowstone Dust$(li)1x Launch Pad

There's not really much to do up there, and they're totally optional, but if you want a void dimension for whatever reason, or just $(italic)really$() like sky diving, they're an option.$(br2)Be sure you bring something to hold on to, as orbits have $(thing)no gravity$().$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Orbits count as a $(item)Cleanroom$() for the purposes of recipe conditions.

pages.name: Space Platform
pages.text: A platform will be constructed for your rocket to land on.

A Zip Gun can be filled up with any of the breathable $(l:the_moon/the_moon#gases)Compressed Gases$() to shoot out air, pushing you around in low gravity environments. They're essential if you want to build anything in orbit!
